entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord in his inmost — divine love itself, the source from which all influx proceeds, the unmeasurable Divine before any accommodation toward the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord in his inmost; the Lord as divine love itself; the source from which all influx proceeds
entries.definition: Named 'Father of Greatness' because all the Lord's principles by which he goes forth proceed from him. He is unmeasurable, beyond name, beyond image. He is established alone in his substance, and the four other Greatnesses are revealed forth from him.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Divine Human — the form love and wisdom take going forth toward the soul; the Lord as Divine Humanity in whom the archetype of human being is held; the Lord accommodating into the form of humanity so the soul has a kindred to recognize.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as the Divine Human; the Lord going forth as the Divine Man; the divine humanity entering the soul's contest
entries.opposite_sense: King of Darkness (the proprium asserting itself as 'I am')
entries.definition: He goes forth from the Father, descends into the contest with the darkness, and is brought up by the Living Spirit — meaning the Lord's accommodation, taking the form of humanity, going down into the natural so the soul is met where it is. His five sons are the rational in five degrees.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's operative divine power by which spiritual structure is built in the soul; the Lord as the operative force that orders the rational and raises the natural toward the spiritual.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's operative power; the Lord as operative force ordering the rational
entries.definition: He brings up the First Man from the contest, builds the cosmos, fashions the storehouses, wears the three garments of wind, water, and fire to operate within the natural — meaning, the Lord operating to give structure, to raise what has fallen, and to set discrete degrees in their proper order.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The divine principle of life-bearing in the Lord — the receptive matrix by which the soul is enlivened; the Lord at the register where his love is the source of the rational's living being.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as life-bearing matrix; the divine principle by which the soul is enlivened
entries.opposite_sense: Hyle / Enthumesis of Death (the proprium's counterfeit life-bearing)
entries.definition: She gives the right hand to the First Man at his contest, embraces him at his return, intercedes for the soul with the Father — meaning the Lord in his life-giving aspect, not a separate goddess. She is the receptive principle by which divine life is borne into the rational.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's call going out to the rational at the moment the natural is ready to hear it; divine truth coming as accommodated revelation that summons the soul to recognize what flows through it.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's call to the rational; the Lord as accommodated divine revelation; the summoning of the soul to recognition
entries.definition: He reveals his image and the Light is chosen forth from the cosmos — the Lord operating at the register where the rational is summoned to recognize what is received. His revelation marks the transition from passive mingling toward conscious discrimination.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine truth shining forth — the Lord as illumining wisdom going to the rational; the active emission of light by which the soul is enabled to see what is given.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as divine truth illumining; the Lord shining forth as wisdom; the Lord giving understanding to the rational
entries.definition: The Coptic name preserves the active verb of shining-forth (ⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ) and must not be flattened to 'Splendor.' He gives eternal life through himself, descends to take the likeness of angels, gathers the Light at the consummation. He is the Lord in his active illumining.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine receivability — the purity by which the Lord is received without corruption; the soul's capacity, when in order, to receive what flows through without claiming it.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as pure receivability; the divine purity by which what flows through is received without distortion
entries.opposite_sense: the defiled receiver; the proprium that claims what flows through
entries.definition: She bears away the heart of the aeons by her image, draws the soul inward to herself — meaning, the perfect form of reception, the Lord at the register where his giving meets the soul's capacity to receive without claiming as its own.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord ordering the rational — truth ordering the inner mind so that the rational can recognize what is its own and what is the Lord's; the Lord's operation of awakening discriminative understanding.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord ordering the rational; truth ordering the inner mind; the Lord awakening discrimination in the soul
entries.opposite_sense: the bound mind; the rational organized by self-love
entries.definition: He awakens sleepers, gathers those scattered, enters the soul to bind the proper members and loose the false. He works inside the natural mind to set each member of the rational into its right place, making the soul able to see in freedom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord at the register where divine love is recognized and returned — the Lord seen as he is loved, the principle of celestial love in receivable form.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as celestial love; the Lord at the register where his love is returned
entries.definition: He is the head of every honor — the Lord at the register where his love makes itself the object of love. The angels are reckoned to his house.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord as divine order itself — the principle by which structure is given to the rational and the natural mind; the Lord operating to set bounds and fitted forms.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as divine order; the Lord ordering the structure of the rational
entries.opposite_sense: the demiurge / Saklas (the proprium organizing apart from the Lord's pattern)
entries.definition: He builds the new aeon, establishes the prison-house of evils where they are to be bound at the end, fashions the orderly structure of regeneration. He is the Lord in his ordering aspect.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord ruling — divine truth in dominion; the Lord recognized as supreme over the natural mind, established at the highest accommodated state.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord ruling; the Lord as divine truth in supremacy over the rational
entries.opposite_sense: King of Darkness (the proprium asserting rule)
entries.definition: He sits enthroned in the seventh firmament, gives judgment of righteousness daily upon all the kingships of the firmaments, turns the wheels of the cosmos. The Lord at the register of governing rule.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The ascent of the natural into conjunction with the spiritual — the path of regeneration as a structural fact; the rational fully formed as the way upward; the regenerated state shouldering what was the proprium's burden.
entries.use_in_reading: the path of regeneration; the natural ascending into conjunction with the spiritual; the way by which the soul rises through the rational
entries.opposite_sense: the descent into self-love; the column of darkness
entries.definition: He bears upward all that is to be raised, stands in the midst of the cosmos. The Lord's ascent operating in the rational, given as a structural pillar — also called the Perfect Man because the rational is fully formed only as it ascends.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The conjugate movement of influx descending and reception returning — divine summons going forth from the Lord and the soul's hearing rising up to meet it; the structural form of the conversation between the Lord and the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the divine summons and the soul's answering; influx going forth and reception returning
entries.definition: The Call (Tōhme) goes down from the Father to the rational; the Hearing (Sōtme) comes back up. Together they form the Great Counsel — the basic pattern of the soul's regeneration: the Lord's truth descending and the soul's reception ascending. Identified with the rational at its 'middle.'

entries.spiritual_meaning: A title of the Lord at the register where divine life proceeds, paired with the Mother of Life — the Lord as begetting principle of the rational's living being.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as begetter of life; the Lord at the register where divine life proceeds
entries.definition: Together with the Mother of Life he establishes the Living Spirit and brings the cosmos into order. The Lord operating in his life-giving aspect.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord at his five distinct registers as he goes forth — Father of Greatness, Mother of Life, Living Spirit, Third Ambassador, Jesus the Radiance — the complete unfolding of the divine outgoing toward the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord at his five distinct registers as he goes forth toward the soul
entries.definition: Not five gods but the Lord articulated in five registers: source (Father), life-bearing (Mother), operative power (Spirit), call (Ambassador), illumining (Radiance). One Lord, five distinct principles.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium asserting itself as source — the soul's 'I am, and there is no other' turned against the Lord; the consolidated form of self-love as it claims what is the Lord's.
entries.use_in_reading: the proprium claiming itself as source; the soul's self-assertion organized as ruling principle
entries.opposite_sense: First Man (the Lord as Divine Human)
entries.definition: Lion-faced and gold-bodied; he rises against the Lord, is cast down, and is finally bound at the consummation. NOT a separate evil god — the proprium taken in its most consolidated, ruling form, the soul's claiming organized as kingdom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The disordered natural — what the soul has claimed and not yet learned is not its own; the proprium as the substrate of self-loving formation; the natural mind producing forms apart from recognition of source.
entries.use_in_reading: the disordered natural; what the soul has claimed and not yet laid off; the proprium producing forms apart from the Lord
entries.opposite_sense: the ordered natural mind; the Living Spirit's body
entries.definition: She paints, fashions, gives birth to forms; she is also called the Enthumesis of Death — the natural mind when it has turned in on itself and now produces from claimed power. The Lord permits her formation so the vessel may take shape; she is finally bound and emptied at the end.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium organizing the natural mind on its own terms; the chief shape of the soul's self-claiming, permitted by the Lord so that a vessel may form.
entries.use_in_reading: the proprium organizing the natural mind on its own terms; the soul's chief self-claiming permitted as vessel-formation
entries.definition: He molds Adam after the image revealed by the Ambassador — meaning, the proprium permitted to take the form of humanity from the divine pattern, so the soul has a vessel of its own to operate from until it matures into recognition.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Particular forms the proprium takes — specific self-loving arrangements of the natural mind; the manifold shapes the soul's claiming assumes when it organizes the natural without recognition of source.
entries.use_in_reading: particular forms of the proprium; specific self-loving arrangements of the natural mind
entries.opposite_sense: the holy ones; the rich; the angels
entries.definition: They organize the storehouses of darkness, hold sway over the firmaments, mold Adam — meaning, the manifold particular shapes the soul's self-claiming takes when it organizes the natural. The Lord permits their forming because freedom requires a vessel.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Disordered states of attention — the rational descending from its proper post and binding itself to lower things; the soul's faculty of watching turned downward and held there until the Lord acts.
entries.use_in_reading: disordered states of watching; attention turned downward and bound there
entries.opposite_sense: the Five Watchers (the rational keeping its post)
entries.definition: They came down from the heavens, were bound in a chain forever in the prison of the darkened ones, begot the giants — the rational descending from order into self-love and remaining bound until the Lord's operation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Failed productions of the proprium — what the soul brings forth from itself which cannot live; the malformed generations of self-love that fall to the natural and form the substrate of further fall.
entries.use_in_reading: failed productions of the proprium; what the soul brings forth that cannot live
entries.definition: They fell down to the earth, were gathered by the Watchers, molded Adam — meaning, what the proprium produces apart from the Lord, which has no life and serves as the material for further self-loving formation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium's claim turned active — the soul's act of taking what is the Lord's as its own; the operative principle of self-love within the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the proprium's active claiming; the soul's act of self-appropriation; self-love operative
entries.definition: Sin runs upward to grasp the image of the Ambassador, mingles with the soul, settles into the body, is finally bound. NOT an external personal evil — the active form of the soul's self-claiming, the propriating motion itself.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity from evil — the wandering of the rational when it has lost its anchor in truth; the soul's state of being mis-led by the proprium's claim.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity from evil; the rational wandering apart from truth
entries.definition: She is sent down with the storehouses, fills the cosmos through self-love and the metarrhismos of pleasure, is finally separated forth and cast into the bolos. The rational's state when it follows the proprium's claim.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The opposed state of the proprium — the soul's claiming when it is most active in resistance to the Lord's influx; the contradiction of love.
entries.use_in_reading: the opposed state of the proprium; the soul's claiming as resistance to influx
entries.definition: The First Man seizes hold of the enmity. The proprium's most active form of resistance, structurally opposite to love. The whole enmity is finally fettered within the rational.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Lower particular self-loves — the proprium's individual cravings and disordered affections that operate beneath the level of organized rule.
entries.use_in_reading: lower particular self-loves; disordered cravings of the natural mind
entries.definition: They surround the body, work to detain the rational. The proprium's diffuse cravings and disordered affections.

entries.spiritual_meaning: What the Lord gives — truth received; influx in its proper register; what the soul recognizes as not-its-own.
entries.use_in_reading: what the Lord gives; truth received as the Lord's; influx recognized as not-the-soul's-own
entries.definition: Light is not a cosmic substance but the soul's reception of what flows from the Lord. The 'light mingled in darkness' is influx that the soul has not yet learned to recognize as the Lord's; the 'light separated forth' is the soul, illumined, recognizing in freedom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: What the soul has claimed — the natural turned in on itself; the absence of recognized truth; the proprium asserting that what flows through it is its own.
entries.use_in_reading: what the soul has claimed; the natural turned in on itself; the proprium's claim asserted
entries.definition: Darkness is not a separate cosmic stuff but the condition of the soul that has claimed and not yet learned to lay off. It 'envelops' the light because the proprium covers what it receives with its own seal of ownership.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Love / will — fire gives light its existence; the active principle that animates wisdom. Living fire = divine love; fire of darkness = self-love consuming.
entries.use_in_reading: love that gives wisdom its life (positive); self-love as devouring fire (negative)
entries.opposite_sense: same word, two directions: living fire vs. fire of darkness
entries.definition: Living fire is divine love giving wisdom its existence. Fire of darkness is self-love that consumes what it receives. Same correspondence — fire as love — different direction. The great consummation-fire is divine love withdrawing what cannot be conjoined.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Truth in the natural degree — what sustains the soul's natural life. Living water = truth ordered; salt water = truth perverted by self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: truth in the natural degree (positive); natural truths perverted by self-love (negative, as salt sea)
entries.definition: Living water (positive): truth received in the natural that nourishes. Salt sea (negative): natural truth that has been turned bitter by the proprium. The water of life is the soul's natural mind ordered by truth received.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Thought / perception — the medium of communication between mind and outer; the moving register by which the rational reaches what it considers.
entries.use_in_reading: thought as movement of perception; the medium by which the rational reaches what it considers
entries.definition: Living wind that breathes (positive) is thought ordered by truth. Wind in its disordered form is the rational's stirring without anchor. The four winds are perception extended in all directions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity from evil — what obscures light; thought blackened by self-love so that wisdom cannot be received clearly.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity from evil obscuring truth; thought blackened by self-love
entries.definition: The world of smoke is the natural mind in its aspect where self-love has turned thought into obscurity. The lion-faced king of smoke is mind ruling itself in falsity-from-evil.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind — the ground where seeds (interior truths) grow; the substrate of formation, two-natured according to whether ordered or claimed.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind as ground; the substrate where interior truths take root
entries.opposite_sense: land of light vs. land of darkness — same ground, two states
entries.definition: The land of light is the natural mind ordered, where truths grow. The land of darkness is the natural mind disordered. Same ground, two states. The 'new land' is the regenerated natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The lowest state of the natural mind — where self-love has its root, where the rational is most enclosed by its own claiming.
entries.use_in_reading: the lowest state of the natural; the soul's farthest from recognition; where self-love has its deepest hold
entries.opposite_sense: the height; the upper place; the inmost
entries.definition: Not a place but a state — the soul's farthest from recognition of source, the proprium at its most claiming, the depth of self-love.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural truth in the mass — particularly when stirred by self-love it becomes the salt sea, falsity flowing; natural perceptions taken collectively.
entries.use_in_reading: natural truth in the mass (general sense); natural perceptions stirred by self-love (when bitter or salt)
entries.definition: The great sea surrounds the cosmos as the bound of the natural. Pearls (precious truths) are formed in it; storms in it are disorder of natural perceptions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity from evil tasted; what should sustain the soul instead afflicts when the proprium has turned natural goods to its own ends.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity from evil as bitter taste; what was meant to sustain afflicting through claiming
entries.definition: The bitter taste of fruits of darkness is what the proprium produces from natural goods. The bitter tree, bitter fruit. What is given to nourish becomes bitter when claimed.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Good of truth received — truth tasted as it is meant; what nourishes when received in its proper order.
entries.use_in_reading: good of truth received; truth tasted in its proper order
entries.definition: The sweetness of waters and the fruit of light corresponds to good-of-truth received. The land of sweetness is the natural mind in right order.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The unregenerate state — where the soul does not yet distinguish what is the Lord's from what it has claimed; light and darkness not yet sorted in freedom.
entries.use_in_reading: the unregenerate state where what is the Lord's and what the soul has claimed are not yet distinguished
entries.definition: NOT extraction of substance but the soul's failure to discriminate. Light is mingled with darkness when the soul has not yet recognized in freedom what is what. Regeneration is the soul, illumined, learning to sort what was mingled.

entries.spiritual_meaning: States of the natural mind preserved in their proper order by the Lord — interior reservoirs of received good and truth that the soul draws upon.
entries.use_in_reading: states of the natural mind preserved in proper order; interior reservoirs of received good and truth
entries.definition: The First Man keeps guard over the five storehouses; the Father's hidden storehouses are where the powers wait until summoned. Each storehouse is a particular ordered state of the natural mind, holding what has been received until called forth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The fixed boundary by which one degree is separated from another so influx can be received without collapse; discrete degrees of the rational held distinct.
entries.use_in_reading: the fixed boundary between discrete degrees; the boundary by which influx is received without collapsing the orders
entries.opposite_sense: collapse of degrees; mingling of what should be distinct
entries.definition: The ten firmaments above; the seven firmaments. They are not domes but discrete degrees fixed by the Lord so that what flows down can be received in order without confusion.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The recurrent process by which the soul is purified, again and again, in freedom; cyclic regeneration; the natural mind's revolving through states under the Lord's ordering.
entries.use_in_reading: the cyclic process of regeneration; the recurrent purification of the rational
entries.opposite_sense: frozen state; no movement of regeneration
entries.definition: The Wheel turns above the firmaments, drawing up and casting down. Not a literal cosmic mechanism but the recurrent purification of the rational — the cycle of states by which the soul is again and again refined as the King of Glory turns the wheels.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A doctrinal vessel carrying truth through the natural — the means by which doctrine is borne over the waters of natural perception; the Lord's ten chariots are the orderly conveyances of his truth.
entries.use_in_reading: a doctrinal vessel carrying truth through the natural; the conveyance of divine truth through the rational
entries.definition: The ships of light (sun and moon as vessels), the ten chariots Jesus mounts, the vessel of light the Ambassador inhabits. Each ship is a particular vehicle of accommodated truth carrying it through the natural mind.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The opening between degrees — where one state opens into another; the passage by which influx enters or recognition rises.
entries.use_in_reading: the opening between degrees; the passage between states
entries.definition: Gates of the firmaments through which the chosen rises; gates of the body opening to perceptions; gate of life vs. gate of death. Each gate is a particular passage from one state to another.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The mark of a state's permanence — what fixes a particular order or claim into the soul's substance; the imprint of either the Lord's order or the proprium's claim.
entries.use_in_reading: the mark fixing a state into the soul's substance; the imprint of order or claim
entries.definition: The Lord's seal upon the body; the seal of the prow; the twelve seals of the wheel. Seals are how an inner state is fixed permanently into the natural — whether the Lord's order or the proprium's claim.

entries.spiritual_meaning: What holds in place — the proprium's grip when the soul has claimed and is held by what it claimed; what fixes a state, whether the Lord binding the proprium or the proprium binding the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: what holds the soul in a state; the proprium's grip on what it has claimed
entries.definition: Bonds and chains by which the rational is held by what it has appropriated; the bond by which the proprium is finally bound at the consummation. Two directions of the same correspondence: what binds the proprium and what binds the soul.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A state in process — a particular degree of the soul's formation as it moves through regeneration; not a temporal period but a structural mode.
entries.use_in_reading: a state in process; a degree of the soul's formation
entries.opposite_sense: aeon of darkness vs. aeon of light
entries.definition: The aeons of the Greatness; the new aeon. Each aeon is a particular state in which the soul exists as it moves through regeneration — not a chunk of time but a phase of being.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind in formation — taken as a whole, the natural mind under construction or in regeneration; the structured field of the soul's outer life.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind as a whole in formation; the structured field of the soul's outer life
entries.opposite_sense: cosmos of darkness vs. cosmos of light
entries.definition: The cosmos surrounded by the fire-wall, fashioned by the Living Spirit. The whole natural mind, with all its degrees, taken as one structure; the field within which the rational is formed.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External truths that clothe spiritual meaning — what the soul wears; the outer expression of inner state, the layers of accommodation.
entries.use_in_reading: external truths clothing inner states; the outer expression of an inner state
entries.definition: The five garments of the First Man (the elements as armor); the new garment of the New Man; the garment of light from the Virgin. Each garment is a layer of truth or appearance the soul puts on or off as the inner state changes.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The form of correspondence — how the spiritual takes shape in the natural; the relation by which a thing carries its source.
entries.use_in_reading: the form of correspondence; how the spiritual takes shape in the natural; the relation by which a thing carries its source
entries.definition: The Lord's image revealed by the Ambassador, the icon of the New Man, the likeness of light. ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ must always be 'likeness,' not varying as form/image/resemblance. Likeness is the structural relation of correspondence itself.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural's complete circuit — the bound within which the natural mind operates as a whole; the structural belt enclosing the cosmos.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete circuit of the natural; the structural belt of the natural mind
entries.definition: The Zone hangs within the cosmos; within it the strongholds and the wheel revolve. The full extent of the natural in its bound, the circuit of the natural mind taken as one enclosing structure.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The place where the proprium is finally bound at the end of regeneration — the gathered mass of self-love sealed off forever.
entries.use_in_reading: the place where the proprium is finally bound; the gathered mass of self-love sealed at the end
entries.definition: The bolos of the last age, the tomb where the proprium is shut in at the consummation. NOT a literal tomb but the final sealing of self-love away from life. The Enemy is finally cast into it and bound forever.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proper post of a faculty — where the rational is set to keep order; the state of attentive maintenance against falling.
entries.use_in_reading: the proper post of a faculty; the state of attentive maintenance
entries.definition: Five watches in the Zone; watches of the Pherrokatochos, the King of Glory, the Pillar, the Omophoros. Each watch is a particular state of attentive presence by which the order of the rational is maintained.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A fixed structure that holds a state firm — defensive enclosure of the proprium, or fortified preservation of received truth, depending on direction.
entries.use_in_reading: a fixed structure holding a state firm
entries.definition: Three strongholds of darkness within the Zone; stronghold of fire. Each is a fixed structure within the natural mind that holds a particular state firm against dissolution.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A state where a particular love takes up residence — the abode of an interior love taken structurally.
entries.use_in_reading: a state where a particular love takes up residence
entries.opposite_sense: dwelling of evils; mansion of self-love
entries.definition: The dwelling-place of fleshes, the tabernacle of the living spirit. Each dwelling is the state of a particular love, with all that flows from it.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The bearing-up principle in the rational — what supports the whole structure from below; the celestial good that holds the natural mind in being.
entries.use_in_reading: the bearing-up principle that supports the rational from below; the celestial good holding the natural mind in being
entries.definition: The great Omophoros bears up under all the burdens, sets foot on the lower lands. The structural bearer who upholds — the Lord operating to hold the natural from sinking into the abyss.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A name for the Lord ordering the highest degree of the rational — the Lord holding the inmost mind firm against falling, the keeper-fast of the natural mind's interior.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord holding the highest of the rational firm; the keeper of the natural mind's interior order
entries.definition: He stands fast in the Great Mind, in the upper place. The Lord operating to hold the rational at its highest post against the proprium's pulling-down.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete gathering of all that is recognized as the Lord's at the consummation — the final form of regeneration, the soul fully come into itself.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete gathering of recognized truth at consummation; the final form of regeneration
entries.opposite_sense: the bound proprium in the bolos
entries.definition: The Last Andrias rises at the end when all that is the Lord's has been gathered together. The consummation of the soul's regeneration as one figure.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Inmost — what is most interior, the inner state turned outward; the essential made present.
entries.use_in_reading: the inmost turned outward; the inner state made present
entries.definition: The Father reveals his face at the consummation. The four faces of the Light. Face is the inmost of any state made visible — the essence in its visible form.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The form of love and wisdom in ultimates — the outermost into which interior life accommodates itself; the structural housing of an inner state.
entries.use_in_reading: the form of love and wisdom in ultimates; the outermost into which interior life accommodates itself
entries.opposite_sense: body of darkness; body of death
entries.definition: The body of the Pillar, the body of flesh, the body of the New Man. Body is whatever serves as the ultimate form for an interior love. The body of man corresponds to the cosmos as the rational corresponds to the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The inmost of the rational — the ruling part of mind, where everything else hangs; the highest degree of the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the inmost of the rational; the ruling principle from which all else hangs
entries.definition: The head of the man, the head of the dragon. The ruling principle from which the rest of the natural takes its order. If the head is severed, the body dies — meaning the highest of the rational holds the rest in life.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Understanding — the faculty by which truth is seen; the rational's organ for receiving wisdom.
entries.use_in_reading: understanding; the faculty by which truth is seen
entries.definition: The eyes open at sunlight. The Father's eyes are the seven luminaries. Understanding receives truth as an eye receives light.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Doctrinal speech — the faculty by which truth is articulated; what the soul utters in its essential confession.
entries.use_in_reading: doctrinal speech; the articulation of truth
entries.definition: The mouth as place of taste and speech. The tongue speaks; the mouth receives the taste. The faculty by which inner state becomes articulated truth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Power as operation — the faculty of putting truth into action; what does or works in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: power as operation; the faculty by which truth is put into action
entries.opposite_sense: hand of the enemy; grasping hand of self-love
entries.definition: The right hand given to the First Man; the hand by which the angel rescues. Hand is the operative power of any state. Right hand specifically marks the Lord's strengthening at the rational's contest.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The lowest natural — what stands on the ultimate ground; the soul's contact with the outermost.
entries.use_in_reading: the lowest natural; the soul's contact with the outermost
entries.opposite_sense: feet of the enemy; foot trampling
entries.definition: Adamas's foot stands on the head of the demon-substance. Foot is what stands in the ultimate, what makes contact with the outermost ground of the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: External love of the natural — what the soul feels at its outermost; in the negative, the proprium's outermost form where Sin most operates.
entries.use_in_reading: external love of the natural; the outermost form into which the soul has accommodated itself
entries.definition: The flesh is the outermost form into which the soul has accommodated itself. Sin most operates in the flesh because it is the outermost claim. The 'flesh-eating' archons are particular self-loves grasping at the outer.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Structural good — the framework that supports; the truth that gives the natural its form and stability.
entries.use_in_reading: structural good supporting form; the truth that gives the natural its stability
entries.definition: Bones of the body, the bones of the man being the framework on which the rest hangs. Bone is the structural good giving the natural its form, the foundational truth that holds shape.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Divine truth proceeding — life-giving circulation through the body of the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: divine truth proceeding; the life-giving circulation of the rational
entries.definition: Where blood appears, it is the circulating life-truth of the body. Limited explicit attestation in this corpus, but the standard correspondence applies.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Degree of perfection — the measure of the rational's full formation; how complete a state has become.
entries.use_in_reading: degree of perfection; measure of the rational's formation
entries.definition: The four sons mounted upon the body; the stature of the First Man. Stature is the measure of how far formation has been completed.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Faculties of perception — the rational's openings to the natural through which the world is taken in.
entries.use_in_reading: faculties of perception; the rational's openings into the natural
entries.opposite_sense: senses turned by self-love; deceived perception
entries.definition: Five sense-organs in the body, gates of perception. Each sense corresponds to a particular faculty of the rational reaching outward.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Perception/knowledge — rooted, growing, bearing; an established arrangement of the natural mind, carrying interior truth from root to fruit.
entries.use_in_reading: perceptions/knowledges; an established arrangement of the natural mind
entries.opposite_sense: beautiful tree (perception ordered) vs. bitter tree (perception turned to falsity)
entries.definition: The two trees — beautiful and bitter — are the same correspondence in opposite directions. A tree is a settled state of perception, with its root in foundational truth and its fruit in works. The five trees are the natural mind in five arrangements.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Works/goods of life — what the tree produces; the action that issues from a state of perception.
entries.use_in_reading: works/goods of life; what issues from a state of perception
entries.opposite_sense: good fruit (works of love) vs. bitter fruit (works of self-love)
entries.definition: Fruits of the beautiful tree are works of love; bitter fruits are works of self-love. Same correspondence, opposite ground. The fruit reveals the tree.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Interior truths — what contains the whole in potential; the inner principle that, when received, grows into perception.
entries.use_in_reading: interior truths in potential; the inner principle that grows into perception
entries.definition: Seeds in the natural ground; new grain in the elements. The interior truth which, sown, grows up as the tree of perception.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Foundational truth — what holds a perception in place; the principle from which a state grows.
entries.use_in_reading: foundational truth; the principle holding a state in place
entries.definition: The root of the tree, the root of all evil. Root is the foundation that holds a state — whether of good or of evil.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Elevated spiritual states — proximity to influx; the height of the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: elevated spiritual states; the height of the rational; states of proximity to influx
entries.definition: Mountains where the natural reaches highest; the great mountain of the natural rising toward heaven. Elevated states of the spiritual mind.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Thoughts, intellectual things — what moves through the air (perception); the mobile contents of the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: thoughts moving through perception; intellectual things
entries.definition: Birds in the air; the bird-faced king. Thoughts at the level of intellectual perception, mobile through the medium of thought.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Lower natural truths — sense-knowledges that swim in the natural waters; truths in the natural degree.
entries.use_in_reading: lower natural truths; sense-knowledges in the natural mind
entries.definition: Fish-faced king of water; fish in the sea. Sense-truths in the natural mind, what moves in the waters of natural perception.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A strong love — celestial good when ordered, violent self-love when disordered; depending on direction.
entries.use_in_reading: a strong love (good or self-love depending on context)
entries.definition: The lion-headed king of fire (self-love organized as ruler); the lions in the sky (good loves). Same animal, two states. Strength of love either toward Lord or claimed by self.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Twisted natural turned in self-love — the proprium's most coiled form; the body of natural mind under proprium-rule.
entries.use_in_reading: the proprium in its most twisted form; the natural mind organized as serpent
entries.definition: Dragon-king of darkness; dragon as enthumesis cast into the sea. The proprium when it has organized itself into a coiled, devouring form within the body.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Celestial good (love); but in the negative, gold is the proprium's claim of what is highest.
entries.use_in_reading: celestial good (positive); self-love claiming the highest (negative — when gold is the body of darkness)
entries.definition: The body of all the powers of smoke is gold (the proprium claims the highest for itself); in proper sense gold is celestial good. Two directions of one correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Spiritual truth (wisdom); in the negative, the proprium's claim of wisdom.
entries.use_in_reading: spiritual truth (wisdom); in negative contexts, claimed wisdom of the natural
entries.definition: Silver of the world of water (positive: wisdom from natural truth); silver as body of water-archons (negative: claimed wisdom). One correspondence in two directions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Natural truth in ultimates — hard, foundational; in the negative, the hardness of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: natural truth in ultimates; foundational hardness of truth (or, negatively, of self-love)
entries.definition: Iron of the world of wind (positive: natural truth foundational); the irons of the bound watchers (negative: hardness of binding self-love). One correspondence in two directions.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Lesser natural truth — alloyed, mixed; the natural in its compounded state.
entries.use_in_reading: lesser natural truth, alloyed; the natural in compounded state
entries.definition: Bronze body of the lion-king. A natural truth alloyed with self-love, less pure than silver or gold.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Lowest natural truth — heavy, base, dragging downward; the natural at its grossest.
entries.use_in_reading: lowest natural truth, base; the natural at its grossest
entries.definition: Lead body of the dark-archons. The lowest, heaviest form of natural truth turned to base ends.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A precious truth from doctrine — the formed result of influx received and held in the natural; truth that has taken form through the soul's reception.
entries.use_in_reading: a precious truth received and formed in the natural
entries.definition: The pearl is formed in the oyster from a drop of rain meeting the right substance — meaning, a precious truth formed in the natural mind from influx that has been rightly received.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Falsity from love of self in the natural — what makes the natural waters bitter.
entries.use_in_reading: falsity from love of self in the natural
entries.definition: The salt of the sea grew from the casting forth of darkness, the metarrhismos of falsity through the natural. The natural turned bitter by self-love at its broadest.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord as illumining wisdom in the natural — the great manifestation of divine truth in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as illumining wisdom; divine truth manifest in the rational
entries.definition: Sun and moon as the two great vessels of light. The sun is the Lord's truth shining forth into the natural mind, the great manifestation of accommodated wisdom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's truth received in the natural — receivable wisdom; the second vessel of light by which influx is held in the natural.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's truth received in the natural; the receivable form of wisdom
entries.definition: The moon-vessel that fills and empties. The receivable form of wisdom, the Lord's truth as the natural mind can hold it.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A state of perception that bears influx — the medium in which truth descends; perception as the carrier of revelation.
entries.use_in_reading: a state of perception bearing influx; the carrier of revelation in the rational
entries.definition: Clouds bring rain; the cloud of light bears the icon of the Virgin. A mediating state of perception by which truth descends into the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Influx coming down from above into the natural; truth received as living water from the higher firmaments.
entries.use_in_reading: influx descending into the natural; truth received as living water
entries.definition: Rain comes from the upper firmaments to nourish the trees and fields. The Lord's life-giving truth descending into the natural mind to enable growth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Particular states of the natural mind — fixed points of the soul's circuit through which it passes; in the negative, particular self-loves bound in the wheel.
entries.use_in_reading: particular states of the natural mind; fixed points in the soul's circuit
entries.definition: Five wandering stars and the zodiac. Each star corresponds to a particular state through which the rational passes in its cycle of formation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete circuit of states the soul passes through in its formation, particularly when those states are turned by self-love; the natural mind in its full revolution.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete circuit of states the soul passes through in its formation
entries.definition: Twelve zodia bound in the sphere; the complete revolution of the natural mind through its states. They mark the cycles by which the rational moves through its degrees.

entries.spiritual_meaning: First of the five faculties of the rational — the highest, where truth is most directly received; the inmost organ of understanding.
entries.use_in_reading: the mind; the highest faculty of the rational; the inmost organ of understanding
entries.definition: First of the five intellectual faculties (Greek loanword νοῦς). The highest part of the rational where the Light Mind enters when the soul is ordered. ALWAYS 'mind' — never anything else.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Second of the five faculties — the movement of mind toward an object; how mind reaches outward to consider.
entries.use_in_reading: the thought; the movement of mind toward what it considers
entries.definition: Second of the five intellectual faculties (Greek ἔννοια). The faculty by which the mind reaches toward what it considers. ALWAYS 'thought.'

entries.spiritual_meaning: Third of the five faculties — what the rational is shaped by; the form-giving faculty by which the soul receives doctrine and is taught.
entries.use_in_reading: the teaching; the form-giving faculty by which the soul receives doctrine
entries.definition: Third of the five intellectual faculties. CRITICALLY: must be 'teaching,' NEVER 'insight' or 'prudence.' The Coptic scribes deliberately chose ⲥⲃⲱ over a Greek loanword. The faculty by which the soul receives form, by which it is taught and shaped.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fourth of the five faculties — practical wisdom, deliberation; how mind shapes its action.
entries.use_in_reading: the counsel; the deliberative faculty by which the soul shapes its action
entries.definition: Fourth of the five intellectual faculties (Greek ἐνθύμησις). The faculty by which the soul deliberates and shapes its action. ALWAYS 'counsel.'

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fifth of the five faculties — the rational's looking-back upon itself; reasoned consideration that completes the cycle of intellectual operation.
entries.use_in_reading: the reflection; the rational's looking-back upon itself
entries.opposite_sense: reflection turned to darkness (called 'law of death')
entries.definition: Fifth of the five intellectual faculties (Greek λογισμός). The faculty by which the mind reasons through itself. ALWAYS 'reflection.'

entries.spiritual_meaning: One rational faculty in its complete process — the rational, articulated in five discrete degrees: mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection. NEVER five separate agents.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational in its five degrees; the one rational faculty articulated in five discrete operations
entries.opposite_sense: the same five turned to self-love
entries.definition: When the corpus enumerates 'five sons,' 'five limbs,' 'five storehouses,' 'five members of the soul,' 'five watchers' — these are not five separate things. They are the same one rational faculty articulated in five discrete degrees of operation. Stage 5 must read them as one faculty in process, not as five distinct agents.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The soul's recognition that what flows through it is the Lord's — the act of seeing what is what; the goal of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the soul's recognition; recognizing what is the Lord's and what is the soul's claim
entries.definition: Knowledge here is not abstract information but the soul's coming to recognize in freedom what is given and what is claimed. The decisive act of regeneration.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The understanding ordered by truth — divine wisdom received in the rational; the right form of reflection.
entries.use_in_reading: the understanding ordered by truth; divine wisdom received
entries.definition: Wisdom of the Virgin of Light; wisdom in the New Man's reflection. The right state of the rational's understanding. Twelve wisdoms = the hours of Jesus the Radiance.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational's faculty of holding states present — what keeps received truth available to the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational's holding of states; what keeps received truth available
entries.definition: Remembrance is given by the senses to the heart, kept in storehouses, drawn forth when needed. The faculty of presence by which received truths remain available.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational's reaching outward through the senses to take in the natural; the basic operation of natural understanding.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational reaching through the senses; natural perception
entries.definition: The senses give to perception; perception gives to thought. The basic outgoing operation of the rational.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's operation of influx — going forth toward the soul; the basic act of accommodation by which the divine reaches the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's influx going forth; the divine going out toward the soul
entries.definition: The Father sends forth emanations; the Spirit summons the powers. The basic operation of influx, the going-forth of divine truth and good.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Accommodation downward — the Lord (or his principle) coming into a lower degree to meet the soul; the divine taking the form of the lower so it can be received.
entries.use_in_reading: accommodation toward the soul; the divine taking the form of the lower so as to be received
entries.definition: The First Man descends into the contest; the rain descends. NOT literal motion. Accommodation: the higher taking the form of the lower so it can be received.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Elevation toward the Lord — the soul, illumined, being raised through degrees; the process of regeneration as upward motion.
entries.use_in_reading: elevation toward the Lord; the soul rising through the degrees of regeneration
entries.definition: The First Man comes up out of the contest; the soul rises through the rational. The soul, recognizing what is given, rises through the degrees of regeneration.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Causative elevation — the Lord's act of lifting the rational; preserves vertical motion, the upward direction of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's causative elevation; lifting the rational upward
entries.definition: ⲧⲟⲩⲱ preserves vertical/directional motion. The Lord's act of lifting the soul or the rational into a higher state. MUST NOT be flattened to 'release' or 'free' — preserve the vertical.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Bringing into order — bringing scattered states together into the right arrangement; the Lord's operation of consolidation.
entries.use_in_reading: bringing into order; gathering scattered states into right arrangement
entries.definition: The angel gathers the soul; the Gatherer-Inward is named among the awakeners. The Lord's operation of bringing into order what was scattered.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The act by which what is the Lord's is distinguished from what the soul has claimed; the basic operation of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: discriminating what is the Lord's from what the soul has claimed
entries.definition: The Lord separates light from darkness, the upper from the lower. The basic operation by which the soul, illumined, recognizes and lays off — the act of regeneration.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The soul's act of telling what is the Lord's from what is its own — done in freedom, illumined from within; the conscious form of separation.
entries.use_in_reading: discriminating, in freedom, what is the Lord's from what is the soul's
entries.definition: Discrimination is what the soul does in regeneration when it has been illumined. It is the conscious, free form of separation — the soul actively recognizing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Withdrawing of evils — the act by which the soul lays off what is not its own; the cleansing operation of the Lord through the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: withdrawal of evils; laying off what is not the soul's; cleansing through reception
entries.definition: The waters are purified. The wind is purified. The rational state is purified by laying off what was claimed. The Lord's cleansing as the soul's recognition.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Perfecting — bringing what was mixed into a pure state; the Lord's act of setting apart what is good in its proper order.
entries.use_in_reading: refining the rational; choosing out what is the Lord's
entries.definition: The Light is refined out of the cosmos. The Ambassador chooses forth the Light from the firmaments. The act of setting apart what is good in its proper order.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's making truth seen — accommodation in the form of vision; the divine taking accessible shape.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord making truth seen; the divine taking accessible shape for the rational
entries.definition: The Ambassador reveals his image; the Father reveals his face at the consummation. The act by which the interior is made present to the rational so it can be received.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's act of giving the understanding light — providing the wisdom by which the rational sees what is given.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord giving understanding its light
entries.definition: Jesus the Radiance is the active illuminating. The act by which the Lord makes the soul able to see what flows through it.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Bringing into union — the Lord's joining of soul to himself; the goal of regeneration as conjunction.
entries.use_in_reading: conjunction with the Lord; the joining of soul to its source
entries.opposite_sense: separation in the bad sense; schism from source
entries.definition: The Father conjoins the soul to himself; the Lord conjoins love and wisdom. The end-state of regeneration is conjunction.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of confusion before discrimination — light and darkness not yet sorted; the basic state of the unregenerate rational.
entries.use_in_reading: mingling — the state where what is given and what is claimed are not yet sorted
entries.definition: Light is mingled with Darkness in the cosmos. The basic state of the unregenerate rational, before the soul has been illumined to discriminate.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Holding in place — what fixes a state; the Lord binds the proprium at the end, but also the proprium binds the soul to itself.
entries.use_in_reading: holding in place (context determines whether good or bad)
entries.definition: The Living Spirit binds the archons; the proprium binds the soul to its claims. Two directions of one correspondence.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Untying what binds — the loosening of what was claimed; the horizontal complement to ⲧⲟⲩⲱ (raise).
entries.use_in_reading: loosening what binds; untying what was claimed
entries.definition: The Releaser looses bonds. The Lord's act of loosening what the soul has bound itself to. CRITICAL: do NOT use 'release' or 'loose' as the primary translation of ⲧⲟⲩⲱ — that is 'raise.' This is the horizontal/dissolving complement.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Shaping into degrees — the operation by which the rational is given structural order; whether by Lord or by proprium permitted to form.
entries.use_in_reading: shaping into degrees; giving structural order
entries.definition: The Lord builds the cosmos; the proprium molds Adam. Forming is the operation of giving structure — when the Lord does it, ordered to regeneration; when the proprium does it under permission, providing the vessel.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Giving external truth as covering — accommodation in the form of garments; the Lord taking on a particular outer form to operate at a particular degree.
entries.use_in_reading: clothing in external truth; accommodation as outer form
entries.definition: The Living Spirit wears the three garments of wind, water, fire. The First Man wears the elements as armor. Clothing is accommodation as outer form by which an inner power can operate at a lower degree.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The soul's accepting what flows from the Lord — the right relation to influx; the opposite of claiming.
entries.use_in_reading: receiving what flows from the Lord without claiming
entries.definition: The soul receives the seal, the gifts, the food, the hope. Receiving is the soul's right relation to influx — accepting without making one's own.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium's act of taking what flows through it as its own work; the basic operation of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: claiming what flows through as one's own; the proprium's appropriation
entries.definition: This is the basic act of the proprium — to claim what is the Lord's as the soul's own. Not a single Coptic word but the operation throughout the corpus that is named by Sin, Error, and Enmity in their personified forms.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The soul's act of letting go of what it had claimed, recognizing it as not its own; the proper end of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: laying off what was claimed; recognizing what is the Lord's; surrendering self-appropriation
entries.definition: The proper end of regeneration: the soul, illumined, lays off what it had taken as its own. Implicit throughout the corpus as the inverse of claiming.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's allowing of the proprium's forming so the vessel may take shape and the soul may exist in freedom.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord permits the natural to form, so the vessel exists in freedom
entries.definition: When the corpus says the archons 'molded Adam,' this is the Lord permitting the proprium to form. Freedom requires a vessel that thinks itself its own. The Lord IS doing this; he simply lets the natural think it does it itself, until the soul is mature enough to recognize the gift.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Bringing what was high in self-love into its proper lower place; the Lord's operation of putting the proprium under.
entries.use_in_reading: bringing the proprium into its proper place; subordinating self-love
entries.opposite_sense: raise (when done to the proprium); subjugate (when done to the soul)
entries.definition: The Living Spirit subordinates the archons. The act of putting the proprium under proper order, where the Lord's truth rules.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's complete operation of making the soul new — the whole movement from claiming to recognition.
entries.use_in_reading: regeneration; the making-new of the rational
entries.definition: The new aeon, the New Man, the new creation. Regeneration is the complete arc the Kephalaia describes — descent, formation, recognition, return.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Living = in conjunction with the Lord, receiving life from him; Dead = separated from the Lord, cut off from the source of life.
entries.use_in_reading: living = in conjunction with the Lord; dead = separated from the source of life
entries.definition: Living Soul, living air, living spirit, living fire — all are the rational receiving life from the Lord. Death is the state of separation from that source.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Pure = without proprium's claim; received and not made one's own; defiled = claimed and turned in.
entries.use_in_reading: pure = received without claiming; defiled = claimed and turned in
entries.definition: The pure are the rational that has laid off; the defiled are still claiming. Holy = set apart for the Lord and recognized as his.

entries.spiritual_meaning: High = inmost, most conjoined, closest to influx; Low = ultimate, most natural, in the outermost.
entries.use_in_reading: high = inmost / most interior; low = outermost / most natural
entries.definition: The Height where the Father dwells; the lower side where the natural mind operates. Vertical motion = degrees of interiority/exteriority, never literal space.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Inner = interior degree, closer to the Lord's reception; Outer = exterior degree, closer to natural action.
entries.use_in_reading: inner = interior degree; outer = exterior degree
entries.definition: Hidden/inner and revealed/outer aspects. The same content has interior and exterior states. The rational's storehouses are within; the senses are without.

entries.spiritual_meaning: New Man = the regenerated rational, in conjunction with the Lord; Old Man = the rational still claiming, bound to self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: the New Man = the regenerated rational; the Old Man = the rational still claiming
entries.definition: The New Man is what the soul becomes when it has laid off; the Old Man is the proprium-bound state. Their members oppose: love vs. hatred, faith vs. doubt, patience vs. impatience, wisdom vs. foolishness.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of conjunction achieved — where the rational has come into peace with the Lord; the consummation of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of conjunction in peace; the consummation
entries.definition: Rest in the new aeon, rest after the contest. The end-state of regeneration — the soul at peace because it has come into right relation with the Lord.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The interior calm of the rational ordered by the Lord — what allows reception; the state in which the soul can receive influx without disturbance.
entries.use_in_reading: the interior calm by which the rational receives without disturbance
entries.definition: The Father is established in stillness; the soul's heart at rest. The state of order in which influx can be received.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of the rational stirred up by the proprium — what prevents reception; agitation from claimed states.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of the rational stirred up by the proprium; agitation that prevents reception
entries.definition: Disturbance comes upon the encampments. The agitated state of the rational when self-love is operative.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The manifestation of the Lord's quality — what shines forth from him; the splendor of divine life as it is recognized in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the manifestation of the Lord's quality; what shines forth from him as recognized splendor
entries.definition: Pillar of Glory, King of Glory, the Glorious One. Glory is the visible quality of the divine in the soul's recognition.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of the proprium when its nakedness is exposed — what self-love feels when its claim is shown false.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of self-love when its claim is exposed
entries.definition: The shame of nakedness; the shame in which the powers fall when the Ambassador reveals.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The bond of greatness — the highest of the New Man's members; love that conjoins; the inmost principle by which the soul receives the Lord.
entries.use_in_reading: love that conjoins; the highest principle of the New Man; the inmost bond of the rational with the Lord
entries.definition: Love is named the bond of the Greatness. Set in the mind of the New Man, it is the principle by which the rational is conjoined to the Lord.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The proprium's first death — the state by which the soul has separated itself from love; structurally opposite to agape.
entries.use_in_reading: the proprium's first death; the soul's separation from love
entries.definition: Hatred is the first death, the state opposite love. From hatred comes envy, from envy the devil-state.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational's confidence in the Lord — the second of the New Man's members; the soul's settled trust.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational's settled confidence in the Lord
entries.definition: Faith placed in the thought of the New Man. The soul's settled trust as the second member.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The soul's enduring through purification — what allows the rational to remain in regeneration without breaking; the fourth of the New Man's members.
entries.use_in_reading: the soul's enduring through purification
entries.definition: Patience as the counsel of the New Man. The endurance by which the soul holds in regeneration despite affliction.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of conjunction realized — the soul's recognition of what it has received; joy is the affect of right reception.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of conjunction realized; joy of right reception
entries.definition: Joy in the new aeon; the joy of the angels at the gift. The right state of the regenerated rational.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational's pressing in regeneration — the suffering of being purified; the necessary affliction of laying off.
entries.use_in_reading: the pressing of regeneration; the suffering of being purified
entries.definition: The soul stands in tribulation as she is purified. The state of the rational in process — pressed but not crushed.

entries.english_term: pillar of light at sunrise / sunset
entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational suffering as it is purified — the soul stretched through the natural until laying off is complete; the soul-in-process.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational suffering as it is purified; the soul stretched through the natural in regeneration
entries.definition: The Cross of Light is the soul stretched through the cosmos in the suffering of being purified. NOT a cosmic crucifixion of trapped light-particles; the rational-in-purification.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Conjunction and polarity — what comes together as opposite-and-complementary; the structural form of meeting and joining (or division).
entries.use_in_reading: conjunction and polarity
entries.definition: Two essences (light and dark), two trees, two embraces, two ships of light. The number that calls for joining or distinguishing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness of process or degree — completeness of unfolding through three states; beginning, middle, end.
entries.use_in_reading: fullness of process
entries.definition: Three days, three wars, three vessels (wind/water/fire), three plagues, three cosmic ages of regeneration. The structural unity of unfolding.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness in extension and ordered manifestation — completeness through four directions, four climes, four stages.
entries.use_in_reading: fullness in extension and ordered manifestation
entries.definition: Four great days, four faces, four wars, four climes, four salvations. The fullness of what extends through ordered manifestation in the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete structure of the natural/rational interface — the rational articulated in five degrees, or the natural mind in its five aspects; the number of full structural articulation at the rational/natural meeting.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete structure of the natural/rational interface; the rational in five degrees or the natural mind in five aspects
entries.definition: Five faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection); five sons; five worlds; five storehouses; five elements; five members; five mysteries; five fathers; five awakeners. ALWAYS read as articulation of one structure in five discrete degrees, NEVER as five separate things.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Fullness in ultimates and holiness — the complete cycle of accommodation in the natural; the holy completeness.
entries.use_in_reading: fullness in ultimates and holiness
entries.definition: Seven firmaments, seven heavens, seven judges, seven seals, seven storehouses, seven days, seven works of the Living Spirit. The number of completeness in the holy ultimate.

entries.spiritual_meaning: New beginning beyond the seven — the eighth firmament, the new aeon; what comes after completeness.
entries.use_in_reading: new beginning beyond the seven; the new aeon
entries.definition: Eight thrones, the eighth firmament where the King of Glory sits, the eighth garment-state. The transition into the new.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Completeness in broader orders — full extension beyond the inner cycle; the structural completeness of the broader order.
entries.use_in_reading: completeness in broader orders
entries.definition: Ten chariots that Jesus mounts, ten firmaments. The number of broad completeness in extension.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Completeness in the broadest order — the fullness of states the rational passes through in its formation; the structural fullness of the cycle of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: completeness in the broadest order
entries.definition: Twelve great aeons, twelve hours of the day, twelve judges, twelve zodia, twelve wisdoms, twelve doctrines, twelve dignities. The fullest structural number in the corpus.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind in five aspects when ruled by self-love — fully articulated proprium; smoke/fire/wind/water/darkness as five orders of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind in five aspects when ruled by self-love
entries.definition: Smoke (mind in falsity), fire (love in self-love), wind (thought disordered), water (truth perverted), darkness (claim itself). Five aspects of the natural mind organized as proprium.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind in five aspects when ordered by the Lord's good — fully articulated good; the rational kept in its proper degrees by the Five Sons.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind in five aspects when ordered by the Lord's good
entries.definition: The five Sons of the First Man preserve the five storehouses. The natural mind in its right aspects, each held by one of the rational's five degrees.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The three structural periods of regeneration — descent into the contest, formation of the cosmos, return through revelation; the arc of the soul's whole regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the three structural periods of regeneration: descent, formation, return
entries.definition: First time: from the descent of the First Man to his return. Middle time: the formation of the cosmos under the Living Spirit. Third time: from the Ambassador's revelation to the consummation. Phases of the soul's regeneration.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The three contests of regeneration — phases of the rational's struggle with the proprium; the structural form of the soul's purification.
entries.use_in_reading: the three contests of regeneration
entries.definition: First, second, third (and a fourth) wars between the Sons of Light and Sons of Darkness. Phases of the soul's regeneration: the rational's contest with the proprium in successive registers.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The three accommodations of the Lord's operative power into the natural — three vehicles by which the Living Spirit acts in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the three accommodations of operative power into the natural
entries.definition: The Living Spirit wears the three garments of wind, water, and fire when he comes to build the cosmos. Each garment is an accommodation by which the Lord's operative power can act at a particular degree.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Light and darkness as the two conditions of the same soul — what is given (light) and what is claimed (darkness); NOT two cosmic stuffs but two states between which the soul is, and which are sorted in regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the two conditions of the same soul: what is given (light) and what is claimed (darkness)
entries.definition: CRITICAL: not two cosmic substances. The two essences are the two states of the same soul — what flows from the Lord and what the soul has appropriated. Regeneration is the soul, illumined, sorting these two in freedom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete circuit of states the soul passes through in formation toward the Lord — the twelvefold completeness of the divine call.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete circuit of states the soul passes through toward the Lord
entries.definition: The twelve great rich gods who are the first calls. Twelve hours of each great day. The fullness of states in the divine outgoing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's discrimination in twelve registers — the complete operation of judgment by which states are sorted; the structural fullness of divine discrimination.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's discrimination in its twelve registers
entries.definition: Twelve judges of might who give judgment of righteousness. The full structure by which the Lord discriminates — at every register and every degree.

natural_variants: peace, right hand, embrace, worship, chirotonia
entries.spiritual_meaning: The five operations by which the rational is sent forth and brought back — the structure of the soul's mission and return; five marks of the rational's covenant with the Lord at outgoing and return.
entries.use_in_reading: the five operations by which the rational is sent forth and returned
entries.definition: Peace, right hand, embrace, worship, chirotonia. Five operations of the rational's outgoing into the contest and its return. The structural form of the rational's covenant with the Lord.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The inmost state of the soul where the Lord dwells — the celestial degree of the regenerated rational; the mansion of love prepared by the Lord.
entries.use_in_reading: the inmost state where the Lord dwells; the celestial degree of the regenerated rational
entries.definition: Where the gods, angels, and rich ones dwell, where the Father is established. The celestial state of the soul — the interior heaven.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The good of love sensed at a distance — the diffusing presence of the Lord's good; what the soul senses of divine love before it is fully present.
entries.use_in_reading: the good of love sensed; the diffusing presence of divine good
entries.definition: The fragrance of the Father; the sweet fragrance from the man. The diffusion of divine good through the natural.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The mark of completed regeneration — the rational fully formed and recognized as the Lord's; the crowning sign of conjunction.
entries.use_in_reading: the mark of completed regeneration; the crowning sign of conjunction
entries.definition: The wreath of light, the diadem given by the third angel. Sign of the soul's regeneration consummated.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational mourning what it sees — sorrow that issues from the recognition of the proprium's situation; the necessary affect of seeing the truth of the soul's bondage.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational mourning what it sees of the proprium's situation
entries.definition: The sons weep when they see the enemy. Three weepings end in stillness; a fourth weeping at the consummation ends with no further weeping forever.

entries.english_term: Father of Life and Mother of Life conjunction
entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord at the register where life proceeds in conjunction — divine love and divine wisdom together giving life to the rational; the Lord's pairing principle.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord giving life through conjunction of love and wisdom
entries.definition: They establish the Living Spirit together; they appoint the storehouses. The pair of life-giving principles in their conjunction — divine love and wisdom acting together.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete structure of what is — taken as one ordered whole; the rational and natural together as the field of the Lord's operation.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete ordered whole of the rational and natural
entries.definition: The All bears under all things; the Pillar of Glory bears up under the All. The total structure within which the soul exists and is regenerated.

entries.spiritual_meaning: What is interior and not yet manifested — the divine in its inmost recess; or what the soul has shut away from view.
entries.use_in_reading: interior and not yet manifested
entries.definition: The Father is hidden in the Greatness; the storehouses are hidden until summoned. Hiddenness is the inmost state, before any accommodation that makes it visible.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The course by which the soul moves through states — the order of regeneration as a way to be walked.
entries.use_in_reading: the course of regeneration; the way through states
entries.definition: Eight paths of darkness, four paths of light. Each path is a course through states — the rational's way home, or its wandering away.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A point of issuing — where a state has its origin; the source-point from which a particular order or evil flows.
entries.use_in_reading: a point of issuing; the source from which a state flows
entries.definition: The wellspring of all evil; the wellspring of demons. The source-point of a particular tendency in the natural mind.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of dominion in the rational — what rules the natural mind; the kingdom of the Lord = regeneration achieved, kingdom of darkness = proprium ruling.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of dominion in the rational
entries.definition: The kingdom — whether of the Lord or of the proprium — is the state where one principle rules. The new aeon is the regenerated kingdom.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational at its highest, where divine influx is most directly received; or, in the negative, the breath of self-love at its most operative.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational at its highest, receiving influx (positive); the breath of self-love (negative)
entries.definition: Living spirit (positive); spirit of darkness (negative). The most interior aspect of the rational, in either direction.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational and its life — the whole inner nature of the human being as it receives life from the Lord; the complete inner life-bearing capacity.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational and its life; the inner life of the human as it relates to the Lord
entries.definition: The living soul stretched through the cosmos in suffering; the soul to be redeemed. The whole inner life of the human as related to the Lord.

entries.spiritual_meaning: STAGE 5 NOTE: ⲧⲟⲩⲱ must always preserve vertical motion. Render as 'raise,' 'cause to stand,' or 'lift up' — never as 'release,' 'free,' or 'save.'
entries.use_in_reading: raise; cause to stand up; lift up
entries.definition: DUPLICATE OF #104, included as note: ⲧⲟⲩⲱ preserves the vertical/causative semantics of the Lord's lifting action and must never be flattened. The complement to ⲃⲱⲗ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ (loose forth, horizontal).
