entries.spiritual_meaning: STAGE 5 NOTE: Where the corpus uses 'captivity,' read it as the proprium's binding of itself or the soul's self-binding through claiming. NEVER as substantial trapping of light particles. The Lord does not need to extract; the soul needs to recognize.
entries.use_in_reading: the soul self-bound by claiming, awaiting recognition; never read as captivity-of-substance
entries.definition: When the Coptic uses captivity language, this is the proprium's self-binding through claiming what was the Lord's. Stage 5 must NEVER produce a 'rescue from prison-planet' reading. The proprium binds itself; the soul is illumined to recognize.

entries.english_term: seal of the firmaments / cosmic body
entries.spiritual_meaning: The whole natural mind taken as a body — each part of the cosmos corresponding to a part of the rational; the natural articulated through correspondence with the human form.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind structured as one body, each part corresponding to a faculty
entries.definition: The cosmos is fashioned in the form of a man: head as firmaments, neck as one cosmos, feet on the lower side, etc. The whole natural mind structured anthropomorphically — the Grand Man pattern in the macrocosm.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A name for the Lord ordering the rational at the level of stable form — the Lord as the standing of the natural mind firm against falling.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord giving stable form to the rational
entries.definition: He stands fast with foot upon the head of the demon-substance, guarding the cisterns. The Lord's operation that stabilizes the natural mind at its proper standing.

entries.spiritual_meaning: A title of the Lord at the register of the formed image born within the natural — the Lord as the regenerated form taking shape in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord as the regenerated form taking shape in the rational; the inner image being born
entries.definition: The Youth set in the midst, born within the rational, the icon of the right-handed call. The Lord at the register where the New Man begins to take shape.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational in its five degrees as it goes forth from the Divine Human — the rational accommodating into the natural through five discrete operations.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational in five degrees going forth from the Divine Human; the rational accommodating into the natural
entries.definition: They go down into the contest with darkness as armor of the First Man; they are the five elements he wears. The rational in five degrees of accommodation downward.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The rational in its five degrees as it operates upward in regeneration — the rational under the Living Spirit's ordering, raising what was below.
entries.use_in_reading: the rational in five degrees as it operates upward in regeneration
entries.definition: They bear up the burdens of the cosmos; they correspond to the Five Sons of the First Man in upward direction. The rational at the same five registers, but operating to raise rather than to descend.

entries.english_term: Twelve Hours of Day / Twelve Wisdoms
entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete cycle of states of the rational illumined — twelve degrees within the great day of regeneration; the structure of wisdom in fullness.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete cycle of states of the rational illumined; the structure of wisdom in fullness
entries.opposite_sense: twelve hours of night (states under self-love)
entries.definition: The twelve hours of the great day are the twelve wisdoms — the days of complete illumination. Each hour is a particular degree of the rational under truth.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind taken as the bound of all natural perceptions — particularly when stirred by self-love, becoming the salt sea where ships of doctrine must navigate.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural mind as bound; natural perceptions stirred by self-love
entries.definition: The great sea encompasses the cosmos; ships sail in it; pearls form at its prow; the great fire-wall stands beyond it. The bounded natural in its outermost form.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete vehicular structure by which Jesus the Radiance descends and operates — ten orderly conveyances of his accommodated truth.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete structure by which divine truth descends in conveyances
entries.definition: Ship of light, abode of First Man, Pillar of Glory, Call, Hearing, living air, living wind, light, water, fire — Jesus mounts these ten as he descends. The full structure of his operation in the Zone.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Settled disorders established by the rational's fall — fixed structures of self-love organized as if they were cities; the proprium given urban architecture.
entries.use_in_reading: settled disorders established as fixed structures of self-love
entries.definition: The Watchers ordered twelve cities for their sons — fixed structures of the proprium organized urbanely.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The transfer of a state from one substrate to another — a soul's particular condition passing from one form to the next; the corpus's structural way of speaking about the persistence of states.
entries.use_in_reading: the transfer of a state from one substrate to another
entries.definition: Metarrhismos in the corpus describes how unrecognized states pass on, taking new forms. Stage 5 should NOT read this as literal reincarnation but as the structural truth that what is not recognized continues to organize itself.

entries.english_term: the New Aeon / aeon of joy
entries.spiritual_meaning: The state of the regenerated rational — where the Lord's order has fully come, where joy of conjunction reigns; the consummation as ongoing state.
entries.use_in_reading: the state of the regenerated rational; joy of conjunction; the consummation as ongoing state
entries.definition: The New Aeon to which the soul comes after the consummation — the state of full regeneration where the Fathers sit on thrones in their houses, in joy.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's discriminating operations at particular registers — each judge a particular faculty of judgment in the rational.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's discriminating operations at particular registers
entries.definition: Great judges in the air, in the firmaments, of righteousness. Each judge is the Lord at a register of discrimination, with the twelvefold structure as the complete cycle.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The final gathering at the consummation — when all that is the Lord's is recognized and brought up; the close of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the final gathering at the consummation; the close of regeneration
entries.definition: The Last Panaretos rises against the bolos; the great gathering of all that has been recognized as the Lord's. The end-form of regeneration as a single act.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The final purification at the consummation — divine love consuming what cannot be raised; the completion of the withdrawing of evils.
entries.use_in_reading: the final purification by divine love; the consumption of what cannot be conjoined
entries.definition: At the end of the cosmos the Great Fire burns and what remains of self-love is consumed. The divine love in its consuming aspect — the final discrimination as fire.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord at the register of governing the seven firmaments — the Lord ruling the discrete degrees of the rational and giving daily judgment.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord ruling the discrete degrees; the Lord giving daily judgment
entries.definition: He sits in the seventh firmament, gives a judgment of righteousness daily upon all the kingships of the firmaments. The Lord as the active ruling judge of the rational's daily states.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete fullness of states honored within the rational — the structural fullness of the rational's accommodated dwellings.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete fullness of states honored within the rational
entries.definition: Twelve dignities established in the cosmos — the structural fullness of dwellings for the rational. Related to but distinct from twelve aeons and twelve zodia.

natural_variants: paths of light and paths of darkness
entries.spiritual_meaning: Four ways of regeneration leading up, eight ways leading to corruption — the structural map of the soul's options through the Zone.
entries.use_in_reading: the structural map of the soul's options through the rational
entries.definition: Four ways are chosen and lead up to life; eight ways lead down to gehenna through the Error. The structural map of the rational's options.

entries.english_term: garment of light / robe of regeneration
entries.spiritual_meaning: The clothing of regenerated truth — the soul wearing what the Lord has given, the outermost sign of conjunction achieved.
entries.use_in_reading: the soul wearing the truth the Lord has given; the outermost sign of conjunction
entries.definition: The third angel comes bearing the garment of light. The covering of recognized truth that the soul receives at consummation.

natural_variants: twelve great ones who came forth
entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's outgoing operations articulated in twelve degrees — the full structure of divine going-forth toward the soul; one Lord in twelve operative registers.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's outgoing operations articulated in twelve degrees
entries.definition: Twelve Greatnesses came forth to fight the Darkness. NOT twelve gods. The Lord's complete outgoing in twelve registers — the structural fullness of his accommodation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete reservoir-structure of the rational — twelve fullness of preserved truth and good held within the natural mind.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete reservoir-structure of preserved truth in the rational
entries.definition: Twelve storehouses with the receivable preservations of truth — extends the five storehouses to the broader-order completeness.

entries.english_term: twelve zodia bound in the sphere
entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural mind's complete circuit of states under the proprium's organization — twelve fixed states of self-love that the soul cycles through.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete circuit of states the soul cycles through under the proprium's organization
entries.definition: The twelve zodia bound in the sphere — the natural mind's twelvefold cycle when organized by self-love. The rational moves through these as it is purified.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete structural articulation of the natural body as it corresponds to the rational — twelve faculties in their bodily form.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete structural articulation of the natural body
entries.definition: The body has twelve members corresponding to the twelve zodia. The natural mind taken in its complete bodily articulation.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The outer bound of love — what holds the natural mind together as one structure; divine love as the outermost limit and protection.
entries.use_in_reading: the outer bound of love holding the natural mind together
entries.definition: The fire-wall surrounds the cosmos; the great fire is at the boundary. Divine love as the outermost bound that holds and at the consummation withdraws.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The five foundational doctrines articulating the rational's covenant with the Lord — same as the Five Mysteries of First Man, taken doctrinally.
entries.use_in_reading: the five foundational doctrines of the rational's covenant
entries.definition: The five sayings to be taught: the structural teaching of the soul's outgoing and return. Doctrinal form of the Five Mysteries.

natural_variants: the five who raise the dead
entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's five operations of awakening the rational from its dead state — the five degrees by which the soul is raised in regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's five operations of awakening the rational from its dead state
entries.definition: Five drawer-uppers who rouse the dead. Each is a particular operation by which the rational, in one of its five degrees, is raised from the proprium's dead state.

entries.english_term: the Twelve Aeons / great aeons of greatness
entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete structure of the divine outgoing — twelve registers at which the Lord is recognizable as he goes forth toward the soul.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete structure of the divine outgoing in twelve registers
entries.opposite_sense: twelve hours of night (the same structure under self-love)
entries.definition: Distinguished from twelve zodia: twelve aeons are the Lord's outgoing in completeness; twelve zodia are the proprium's mimicking circuit. Complement at full order.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The conjunction of love expressed as nearest contact — the soul united with the Lord at the moment of regeneration.
entries.use_in_reading: the conjunction of love expressed as union
entries.definition: The Mother of Life embraces the First Man at his return; the soul is embraced at her redemption. Conjunction in its closest form.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The natural body in five aspects — the bodily complement to the five worlds of darkness; the natural in its sensory/bodily articulation.
entries.use_in_reading: the natural body in five aspects; the bodily articulation of the natural
entries.definition: Five worlds of flesh corresponding to the five worlds of darkness. The bodily articulation of the natural mind — what the soul wears at its outermost.

entries.spiritual_meaning: Two registers at which the proprium organizes itself into ascending self-love — the dry and the moist as the masculine and feminine forms of self-love.
entries.use_in_reading: two registers of ascending self-love
entries.definition: The two anabibazons reckoned with the five planets — the polar pair of the proprium's organized self-love (Father-figure and Mother-figure of darkness).

entries.spiritual_meaning: Right hand = the Lord's strengthening operation; in body, the higher operation. Left hand = the lower operation.
entries.use_in_reading: right hand = the Lord's strengthening / higher operation; left hand = lower operation
entries.definition: The Mother gives the right hand to the First Man at his contest. The right hand of the body corresponds to the higher half of the rational; the left to the lower.

entries.english_term: twelve hours of night / shadows of darkness
entries.spiritual_meaning: The complete cycle of states under self-love — twelve aspects of the natural mind in darkness; the dark complement to the twelve hours of day.
entries.use_in_reading: the complete cycle of states under self-love
entries.definition: Twelve shadows of darkness corresponding to twelve hours of light. The full structure of the natural mind under the proprium's organization.

entries.spiritual_meaning: The Lord's reserves not yet brought into operation — what the Lord holds in his inmost until the moment for it has come.
entries.use_in_reading: the Lord's reserves not yet manifested; what is held in the inmost until the moment
entries.definition: Hidden storehouses from which powers are summoned when needed; at the consummation the Father reveals his face into them and gathers them. The Lord's inmost reserves.

entries.english_term: Three Things shown to First Man
entries.spiritual_meaning: Three structural distinctions of the regenerated rational — the icon, the structural bond with the Five Sons, and the seal of the cosmos within him.
entries.use_in_reading: three structural distinctions by which the regenerated rational is exalted
entries.definition: The image of the Most High set upon him; the molding through firstborn-state of heaven; the seal of all powers and counsels gathered within. Three exaltations of the regenerated rational.

entries.english_term: the four wars and four salvations
entries.spiritual_meaning: The fourfold structure of contest and salvation — the rational's struggle and the Lord's deliverance articulated in the fullness of ordered manifestation.
entries.use_in_reading: the fourfold structure of contest and the Lord's deliverance
entries.definition: Four wars: First Man, Living Spirit, Ambassador, Jesus the Pope-Eau. Four salvations: corresponding deliverances. The fourfold structure of the soul's regeneration as combat and redemption.

methodology_note: This lexicon was built by reading the entire substrate as a single field and extracting load-bearing terms whose natural/cosmological forms teach a spiritual process. The Coptic glossary was treated as authoritative wherever it gave a mandatory rendering — particularly for the five faculties (mind, thought, teaching, counsel, reflection), for ⲧⲟⲩⲱ (raise), for ⲡⲉⲓⲛⲉ (likeness), and for ⲡⲡⲣⲓ̈ⲉ (Radiance). Where Coptic and English diverged, I followed the Coptic. The governing principle has been kept rigorously: there is one soul, not two armies; luminous figures are the Lord in his distinct principles; proprium figures are forms of the soul's claiming, permitted by the Lord so the vessel can form. Captivity language has been refused as a misreading. Numbers have been treated as correspondences of structural completeness, and the recurrent fivefold (faculties, sons, worlds, watchers, storehouses) has been read as ONE rational faculty in five degrees of process — never as five disjoint agents. Where the corpus uses the same word for opposite-direction states (fire, water, sea, lion, gold, silver, iron), entries note that the correspondence holds in two directions according to the love that animates them. The lexicon directs stage 5 toward the spiritual register of regeneration consistently across the corpus.
